name: Derya Durmaz
bio:
Derya Durmaz is a actor and director.

Her first short film Ziazan (2014) received 11 awards from 43 festivals in 19 countries.

credits.title: Will You Come With Me?
credits.overview: A small story born in Berlin, the city that fools you with its liberal outlook and makes you feel that all the problems of patriarchy and gender inequality are solved there. But then you discover that things are still not so different from how they were in the dark days of the past.

credits.overview: Two teenage best friends travel from the UK to Istanbul with plans to cross into Syria in search of a new life, but when their contact fails to appear, they must navigate an unfamiliar city while confronting the limits of their courage, faith and friendship.

credits.title: Elaha
credits.overview: Facing societal pressure to restore her virginity before her upcoming wedding, a 22-year-old woman struggles to afford a hymen reconstruction operation while questioning the oppressive expectations placed upon her body.

credits.overview: As an unexpected truth about a young women gets revealed to her mother, the basic fact that a mother - daughter relationship is supposed to be based on unconditional love will have to be questioned.

credits.overview: Nehir comes across to someone singing songs all night long. She likes what she listens so much that she goes after this mysterious musician.

credits.overview: 4 years old Armenian girl Ziazan one day decides to go on an adventure. She will sneak in from Armenia to Turkey inside her uncle's luggage. Will she be able to go over the closed borders between 2 countries and realize her adventure?

credits.title: Do Not Forget Me Istanbul
credits.overview: Several directors from countries of the region were invited to create stories taking place in and around the beautiful city of Istanbul, in the vein of “Paris, je t’aime” and “New York, I love you”. They come together to remind viewers that Istanbul’s history does not belong only to the people of Turkey.
